fields.name: incidentDate
fields.label: Incident date
fields.meaning: Date on which the incident occurred.

fields.name: incidentNotificationDate
fields.label: Incident notification date (FNOL)
fields.meaning: Date when this claims handler was first notified of the incident by anyone, not necessarily the claimant. Not the date another insurer or organisation was notified.

fields.name: incidentCountry
fields.label: Country of incident
fields.meaning: Country where the incident occurred; recorded as entered without inferring applicable law.

fields.name: claimantName
fields.label: Claimant name
fields.meaning: Name of the claimant, whether a private person or a company. No separate party-type or legal-identity fields.

fields.name: insurerName
fields.label: Allegedly responsible insurer
fields.meaning: Name of the insurer claimed to be responsible. This does not establish ultimate liability or a recourse-chain position.

fields.name: claimedAmount
fields.label: Amount claimed
fields.meaning: Amount claimed by the claimant, encoded as exact non-negative decimal text. Zero is a recorded amount, not a substitute for unknown.

fields.name: claimedCurrency
fields.label: Currency of claimed amount
fields.meaning: Three-letter uppercase identifier for the claimed amount; no currency conversion or registry inference.

fields.name: caseReference
fields.label: Handler's case reference
fields.meaning: Reference assigned by the claims handler operating this register, not an insurer reference. Unique, immutable and case-sensitive within one installation.

fields.name: paymentDecisionDate
fields.label: Payment decision date
fields.meaning: Date when this claims handler decided the amount to be paid. Null until a decision is recorded; not a payment or bank instruction.

fields.name: payableAmount
fields.label: Amount to be paid
fields.meaning: Decided amount to be paid, in exact non-negative decimal text. Null until decided; may differ from the claimed amount.

fields.name: payableCurrency
fields.label: Currency of amount to be paid
fields.meaning: Currency of the decided amount. Null until decided; it need not equal the claimed currency.

fields.name: paymentDate
fields.label: Payment date
fields.meaning: Date when the decided amount was actually paid, as recorded by the operator. Null while unpaid or unknown. One full payment only; recording does not execute or independently verify a bank transfer.

fields.name: status
fields.label: Case status
fields.meaning: Administrative state OPENED or CLOSED, independent of decision and payment. No additional case statuses.

commands.label: Open a case
commands.meaning: Create the basic record. No decision or payment is inferred.

commands.label: Amend registration
commands.meaning: Replace the initial facts. The handler's case reference remains unchanged.

commands.label: Correct case facts
commands.meaning: Correct existing decided, paid, or closed case facts atomically. Keep reads accepted values; clearing a payment record does not reverse an external transfer.

groups.name: registration
groups.label: Registration
groups.meaning: Keep the accepted registration facts or replace all seven registration inputs together.

groups.name: decision
groups.label: Payment decision
groups.meaning: Keep the accepted decision, replace its complete date, amount, and currency tuple, or clear it.

groups.name: payment
groups.label: Payment record
groups.meaning: Keep the accepted payment record, replace its date, or clear the recorded payment date; clearing does not reverse an external transfer.

commands.label: Record payment decision
commands.meaning: Record or replace the decided amount and currency. This does not send money.

commands.label: Withdraw payment decision
commands.meaning: Remove the unpaid decision tuple while retaining its earlier history.

commands.label: Record actual payment
commands.meaning: Record the date the full decided amount was actually paid. This does not execute or verify a transfer.

commands.label: Correct an erroneous payment record
commands.meaning: Remove an erroneously recorded payment date. This is not a refund or reversal of an actual transfer. Earlier history remains.

commands.label: Close the case
commands.meaning: Set the case status to CLOSED. Closing does not imply any payment.

commands.label: Reopen the case
commands.meaning: Set the case status to OPENED, retaining its other fields and history.

rules.meaning: The command target must equal the accepted case reference.
Incident, notification, decision and payment dates must remain chronological.
Newly recorded event dates cannot be after the effective business date.
Decision date, payable amount and payable currency are present together or absent together.
A payment date requires a complete, positive decision.
OPEN is the only command that creates a case and it requires no current case.
OPEN requires expected revision zero.
Every command other than OPEN requires an accepted current case.
Every change checks the authoritative accepted revision before transition.
A closed case permits only REOPEN; it must be reopened before other changes.
Registration facts may change only while the case has no decision.
CORRECT_CASE changes only existing decided, paid, or closed case facts; it cannot add a decision or payment group that is absent.
CORRECT_CASE validates the complete resulting state and records one revision without a cleared intermediate snapshot.
Replacing a paid decision requires explicit replacement or clearing of the payment record.
A decision may be added or replaced only before payment is recorded.
Decision withdrawal requires an existing unpaid decision.
Recording payment requires an existing unpaid decision and may occur once.
CLEAR_PAYMENT requires an existing recorded payment date.
CLOSE applies only to an opened case.
REOPEN applies only to a closed case.
